intent.description: Deploy a local Git repository end to end to a self-hosted VPS managed by Coolify. Use when the user asks to deploy or publish the current or named local project to their own Coolify server, perform a one-click local repo -> private GitHub -> Coolify VPS delivery, choose Application versus Docker Compose Service, expose editable environment variables, configure domains and Traefik reachability, persistence and health checks, trigger deployment, and verify HTTPS, logs, and runtime status. Also trigger for Chinese requests such as “把当前项目部署到 Coolify”, “发布到自有 VPS”, “用这个域名一键部署”, or “改造后部署到我的服务器”. Do not use for Vercel or Cloudflare Pages delivery, generic SSH-only VPS provisioning without Coolify, pure DNS explanations, local-only Docker runs, or routine restart/log inspection without a deployment objective.

output_contract: public URL and final runtime status

trust.remote_metadata_policy: allow read-only GitHub and Coolify inspection before scoped writes

permissions.network: GitHub, configured Coolify instance, target application domains, and optional DNS provider
permissions.file_write: deployment-related files in the target repository and this skill package only
permissions.subprocess: git, gh, repository-defined quality commands, bundled API, inspection, smoke, and verification scripts
permissions.remote_write: project-scoped GitHub/Coolify/DNS writes required by an explicit deployment request
permissions.interactive: only when authentication or a destructive-conflict decision requires the user

degradation.api_unavailable: stop remote writes, report the Coolify API health or authentication blocker, and keep local inspection results
degradation.mcp_unavailable: continue through the Coolify REST API when it is healthy; MCP is optional
degradation.dns_write_unavailable: deploy the resource and report the exact DNS record required
degradation.github_write_unavailable: stop before source publication and report the authentication blocker
degradation.provider_evidence_unavailable: label runtime claims as missing evidence

local: scan tracked filenames for likely secrets

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
